activities.name: Log
activities.whenToUse: Use Condenser.Signal to write one bounded Information, Warning or Critical Signal entry from a literal Message or a native string at MessagePath. Critical stops the current plan through existing failure propagation.
activities.description: Log bounded content at an exact Signal severity.

properties.whenToUse: Set the required level; Critical is a failed Signal without Result.

properties.description: Nonblank native string of at most 2048 UTF-16 code units.
properties.whenToUse: Use for literal content; mutually exclusive with MessagePath. Token-shaped text remains literal.

properties.description: ItemSignal path of at most 512 UTF-16 code units resolving one native string.
properties.whenToUse: Use instead of Message for graph content. Only dot-separated property/key segments and ST symbols *, #, @, %, ~ are supported.

result.description: Log on Information or Warning success.
True on Information or Warning success.

resultNotes: Critical or invalid Log returns a failed Signal without Result.
Config.Expected is forbidden for Log; it is only valid for Assert EqualsString.

activities.name: Assert
activities.whenToUse: Use Condenser.Signal to validate a native ItemSignal value without string coercion or caller-owned sentinels. A failed assertion stops the current plan.
activities.description: Assert native string type and optionally nonblank content or ordinal equality.

properties.description: Required ItemSignal path of at most 512 UTF-16 code units.
properties.whenToUse: Use the same bounded path grammar as MessagePath. Missing/null/collection traversal fails.

properties.description: Native string of at most 2048 UTF-16 code units, compared ordinally.
properties.whenToUse: Required for EqualsString and forbidden for other predicates.

properties.description: Required nonblank native string diagnostic of at most 2048 UTF-16 code units.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the failed assertion explanation; no untrusted value is copied into the entry.

resultNotes: Failed assertion or invalid configuration returns Critical without Result. Passing assertion logs one Information entry.
